name: roku-mcp
description: Unofficial. Roku device automation for Claude Code: sideload deploy, ECP remote control, screenshots, debug console, runtime SceneGraph UI editing, BrightScript and Perfetto profiling, and stream failure diagnosis. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Roku, Inc.

ROKU_DEVICE_HOST.title: Roku device host
ROKU_DEVICE_HOST.description: IP address or hostname of the Roku dev device. Leave empty to use SSDP discovery.

ROKU_DEVICE_PASSWORD.title: Roku developer password
ROKU_DEVICE_PASSWORD.description: Developer mode password set on the Roku device.
